scope: Review and correct all six characters against original style references.

prompts.Warrior:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: corrected full-body game character.
INPUT ROLES: Images 1 and 2 are the user's ORIGINAL DRAWING-STYLE authorities. Image 3 is ONLY the current character design to preserve while correcting how it is drawn. The style in images 1/2 outranks the more polished generated rendering of image 3. Do not copy reference identities, poses, weapons, text or signatures.
Redraw with the originals' economical expressive cartoon: robust dark ink silhouette with selective irregular line weight, a few meaningful interior lines, large quiet areas, playful strong shape design. A form gets a base color and one broad shadow that describes its mass. Avoid tiling every muscle, cloth fold and armor plate with separate little triangles. No low-poly look, bevel shading, glossy metal rendering, soft airbrush, gradient, glow, halo, dithering, grain or speckled texture. Broad intentional shadows rather than geometric tessellation. This is simplified drawing, not lower image resolution and not a featureless icon.
Adult stylization, head/hands/feet readable at small scale, short neck, compact torso and legs like the originals. Do not fill a tall page by stretching anatomy or enlarging hair/hat to disguise a tiny skull. Preserve character-specific visual identity and readable practical equipment. Restrained muted colors with one small accent.
One complete full-body character only, native 1024x1536 portrait canvas on genuine transparency. All feet and weapons visible, clear margins, leave empty space if needed. No background, ground shadow, glow, vignette, text, watermark or extra character.
CHARACTER AND REQUIRED CORRECTION:
Preserve exactly this practical beginning male Warrior's design: enclosed iron helmet and black visor, original worn olive short shoulder mantle with its already-cleaned simple front fold, ochre neck scarf, iron breastplate and shoulder armor, leather gloves and boots, one-handed short broad sword and wood shield. No white fabric, no new crest, no ornate paladin, no naked face, no new cloth streamers. Keep his original solid compact build; do not elongate him. CORRECTION: armor and blade should have broad dull planes with just one light edge where needed, not clusters of separate reflection facets. Sleeve and shin shapes should be broad quiet color masses. Retain functional armor pieces but remove gratuitous highlight polygons and redundant internal scratches. Keep original silhouette, humble equipment value and the approved front-cloth cleanup.

This is an economical CHARACTER DRAWING, not a rendered illustration: large quiet flat color fields, sparse interior ink marks, slightly irregular confident contour. The face should be as simply stated as the reference caster's face: eyebrows, eyes, ONE small angular nose mark and a smile. FACE SKIN ONE BASE COLOR AND AT MOST ONE BROAD SIDE SHADOW. No separate cheekbone planes, nose-side render, lip shading, under-eye facets or small skin highlights. A few restrained age lines are enough. SHORT GREY BEARD A SINGLE COHERENT SILHOUETTE WITH ONE SIMPLE SHADOW, no tessellated silver spikes or strand rendering. Hair grouped in a few large swept-back locks, no more than one simple dark mass.
Subject: kind curious HUMAN man aged 65–70, receding swept-back silver-grey hair, short neat grey beard/moustache, warm small smile and alert eyes; approachable grandfather, not a scowling eccentric or a young heroic pretty face. Bare head, no wizard hat. Compact adult cartoon body, generous actual skull/face, short neck, torso and legs compressed like the supplied originals rather than realistic long anatomy. Adult hands and feet, not a baby/chibi.
Maintain this game's established scholar design through these exact simple pieces: CLEAN muted dusty-blue shoulder cloak, burgundy split long tunic with cream collar/cuffs, one plain brown belt, charcoal loose trousers, brown boots. He holds ONE OPEN BROWN BOOK IN BOTH HANDS at the chest. A SHORT SHEATHED DAGGER at the waist (not a sword) and a plain straight wooden STAFF STRAPPED DIAGONALLY ON HIS BACK (not held in his hands). No owl, pet, extra pouch, jewelry, scroll bundle, gold embroidery or crown.
Cloak: ONE flat blue base plus ONE large dark underside shape, very few fold lines. Tunic: ONE flat burgundy base plus ONE broad structural shadow. Trousers and boots: large quiet areas and a couple of joint folds. Do not break these areas into decorative triangular patches. The references' cartoon energy comes from proportion and gesture rather than shading complexity.

Full body with both boots, complete staff and dagger visible with margins. Native high-resolution artwork on genuinely transparent background; empty margins are fine, never stretch the body to fill a tall canvas. One single character, no ground shadow, scene, text, label or watermark.

Samurai.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One original adult MALE SAMURAI drawn in the compact expressive dark-fantasy cartoon language of the two supplied ORIGINAL STYLE REFERENCES.
Do not use previous AI Samurai anatomy: it was rejected for having a small head, long neck, long narrow torso and long legs. This is a fresh complete drawing guided by the two originals.
CANVAS: native high-resolution SQUARE 1536 x 1536, true transparent background. The square composition should support a compact broad grounded standing figure, not a stretched tall fashion-model figure. Full body with comfortable margins and all sword/scabbard/feet visible. Do not reduce native image quality or use coarse pixels.
Subject identity to preserve: a handsome East Asian ADULT MALE wandering Samurai about age 30, long black hair tied LOW AT THE NAPE, a few large front locks, serious calm eyes and composed mouth. Masculine adult jaw and broad shoulders, not a child, baby/chibi, woman, youthful anime idol or hugely muscular barbarian. No chest bandages or bare midriff.
IMPORTANT PROPORTIONS: actual SKULL CROWN TO CHIN is large and readable, roughly one fifth of his standing body height. Do not count the ponytail/hair spikes as the skull measurement. Short sturdy neck: head sits naturally close above the shoulders, never a long thin stem. Compact medium-width ribcage and waist. Shorter robust legs under broad trouser masses. Large capable adult hands and feet like the originals. Use the original white-hood swordfighter's generous head/body relationship and grounded posture, while keeping a male body. If he reads as a long-legged manga model, the drawing is wrong.
Exact established wardrobe: closed muted dark olive kimono with a simple cream inner collar, small rust-red waist sash with SHORT restrained ends, charcoal loose cropped hakama trousers, plain forearm wraps and practical sandals. ONE PROMINENT practical three-plate dark iron shoulder guard on the left shoulder; preserve that strong layered shoulder silhouette, without spikes, gold, breastplate or armor elsewhere. A normal sheathed katana at the hip, one hand resting on its hilt in a ready-to-draw pose and the other relaxed. The upper body three-quarter turn and feet placed apart feel composed and sturdy. No new cape, hat, jewelry or elaborate ornament.
Drawing style: hand-inked irregular near-black contour, a few economical interior marks, clean big flat color fields and one broad shadow per form. Face in a handful of lines and a single restrained shade, NO tiny eye shine, eyelid rendering, cheekbone planes or polished anime portrait. Hair in a few broad locks. Cloth has large quiet planes and two or three structural folds, not tessellated little triangles. Steel shoulder plates have dull flat body and one light edge, not a collection of rendered facets.
No gradient, glow, halo, texture noise, dithering, airbrush, glossy rendering, photorealism, low-poly shading, pixelation, scenery, ground shadow, text, signature, watermark or additional characters.
The inputs specify drawing language, simplicity and proportions only: do not copy the woman, monkey, their identities or exact costumes. Produce the described mature male Samurai with the deliberately compact anatomy.
